_doc: Sapphire gTileset_GenericBuilding (+ gTileset_Building primary) metatiles -> Black 2 room parts, read by converter/gen_interior_recipes_houses.py. Metatile ids are 3-digit hex (0x200+ = GenericBuilding). Sapphire draws a room's back wall as two rows: 'walltop' (the top row, also the tops of tall furniture) is wall; the row under it is the furniture row and becomes floor (as Littleroot's rooms). Objects are found by their 'anchor' metatile = top-left tile of the solid footprint (w x h tiles); an anchor directly under a walltop tile stands against the back wall (wall N). Kinds: m = one Black 2 interior model over the footprint; fill = that model on every tile (long = a longer model per 'len' tiles of a row); fit = as many copies of a model 'fit' units wide as fit, evenly spaced, no overlap; run = the footprint widens to the right over the listed metatiles. Seats get pushed away from a neighbouring round table and lifted onto rugs.
void_doc: the octagonal corners of Pacifidlog/Fortree rooms (3e6/3e7, 3cc/3cd) stay floor (solid by Sapphire's collision): notches there only made stray wall stubs

partition._doc: not floor: walls are built around them (Sapphire's white room dividers; Fortree's tree trunk)

divider._doc: Sapphire's white room dividers (a thin wall standing in the room: Dewford Hall, Rustboro Flat 2, Wanda's house): floor + a raised block as high as the walls, its sides in the room's wall texture, a light top (Black 2 caps outer walls in black, which made a black slab in the middle of these rooms: story_fixups 2026-10-07; the top is the facilities agent's partition top, fac_partition). Divider tiles on the top wall row stay wall

seats._doc: Sapphire's walkable chairs and floor cushions -> chushion01 (Black 2 puts chairs only on solid tiles, cushions on walkable ones); a seat beside a table01 is pushed seat_dx units away from it (the round table is 2.8 tiles wide); the tables are table01_2x2 now (Sapphire's 2x2, rooms_cleanup), so seats stay on their tiles

wall_things._doc: things on the back wall, anchored on Sapphire's walltop tile (centre of that tile unless dx); gap 2 = 2 units off the wall (closer layers flicker in melonDS)

2e4._what: wood post, right edge of the tile

2ee._what: the Trick Master's hole in the wall / Fossil Maniac's tunnel

21b._what: hanging scroll over the Trick House door (Sapphire's 'Door' sign)

rugs._doc: rug metatiles by kind (incl. tiles of furniture standing on the rug); one rug per connected group, over its bounding box

mats._doc: door mats (exit warps) and the concrete entrance strip of the Japanese rooms

signs._doc: Sapphire's furniture with a message by metatile behaviour (field_control_avatar.c), as signs readable from any side

add._what: door (2,1) to the corridor (Sapphire's doorway in the back wall; rooms_cleanup: it had no model)

rooms._doc: hand fixes per room, applied after the table (see the generator's docstring)
